column15: bit 0 = Invalid address; bit 1 = Sensor range exceeded; bit 2 = Sensor error; bit 3 = No sensor; bit 4 = User settings invalid; bit 5 = Factory settings invalid; bit 6 = External memory failure; bit 7 = Internal memory failure
0 = Dew point (°F); 1 = Dew point (°C); 2 = Relative humidity (%RH); 3 = Enthalpy (BTU/lb); 4 = Enthalpy (lb/million ft3); 5 = Absolute humidity (kJ/kg); 6 = Absolute humidity (g/m3)
